units.source_text: 今天这回是最后一次，嗨，干脆就卖三元五角吧。

en.t: Today is the very last time for this lot; all right, let us just sell it for three yuan fifty.

units.source_text: 来，请吧，请拿起来看看再买。

en.t: Come on, please, pick it up and have a look before you buy.

units.source_text: 说实在的，即使有人要买下这里的全部产品，

en.t: To tell the truth, even if someone wanted to buy every item here,

units.source_text: 让我们打折扣减价，价格也不会比这更低了。

en.t: and asked us to discount the price, it would not get any lower than this.
